repairs.quote: Locke teleports to a location, dealing (40/50/60/70/80 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage to nearby enemies on arrival. On his next Attack, he dashes to his target, dealing (40/60/80/100/120 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage to all enemies in his path. Each hit consumes Soul Nails. If Locke scores a takedown, the Cooldown of this Ability is reset.
